correctness.rationale: The update matrices exactly match the published KGSM rule on orthogonal diagonal rows. Algebraically det(I-Q)=p(1-beta)F, Q is a positive covariance operator with real nonnegative Perron spectral radius, F has exactly one positive root, and the strictly positive first-step covariance forces sharp nondecay/growth above it. All parameter boundaries M=0, beta<1, p in (0,1), M=1 are addressed. The standalone SymPy script passed 240 exact path-moment identities and symbolic determinant/factorizations; enumeration is corroboration, not proof.
